_what: The brand onboarding checklist, machine-readable. The 'activate Prizm Lab' flow (CLAUDE.md at the repo root) walks it one item at a time. The same list for people is ONBOARDING.md beside this file.

items.name: Your brand's name
items.why: Every tool files its work under your brand's folder and writes your name in ads.
how: answer a question
items.ask: What's your brand called, written exactly the way it appears in your ads?

items.name: Your website
items.why: Claude reads it to fill in most of the rest for you, so you type as little as possible.
tools: onboarding (Claude reads it for the items below)
how: paste a link
items.ask: What's your website address?
fills: README.md (one line: what this brand is, and the site)

items.name: Your brand story
items.why: Video scripts, emails and stories are told through it.
how: Claude drafts it from your website's About page
you confirm or correct it
items.ask: Here's the story I read off your site — what's wrong or missing?

items.name: What you claim, and why it works
items.why: Every ad, page and brief is checked against it; it's the base everything else reads.
how: Claude drafts it from your site and reviews
answer a few questions
items.ask: In one sentence: who is this for, what does it do, and why does it work when other things didn't?

items.name: Your logo, colours and fonts
items.why: Pictures and videos come out on-brand instead of generic.
how: drop files (logo — PNG or SVG)
Claude reads colours from your product photos
Claude reads fonts from your website
items.ask: Drop your logo here (a PNG with a clear background is best). Do you have brand fonts, or should I use what your site uses?
items.claude_can_fetch: fonts and colours from the website

items.name: The one message every ad carries
items.why: Lets the creative tools check every ad says the same core thing.
how: Claude proposes it from your position and reviews
you pick or reword
items.ask: If a customer remembered one sentence from your ads, what should it be?

items.name: Your best-selling product
items.why: Every brief, script and image is built around a real product with real facts.
how: paste the product page link — Claude fetches the facts
drop product photos (or Claude saves them from the page)
items.ask: What's your best seller? Paste the link to its product page.
items.claude_can_fetch: name, price, ingredients/specs, claims, photos from the product page

items.name: Any other products you want ads for
items.why: Lets you make ads for more than the best seller.
how: paste product page links
items.ask: Any other products you want to make ads for? Paste their links, or say 'not now'.

items.name: Your main offer
items.why: Every ad sells into one offer; tools use it for the call to action and to check links.
how: paste the offer or landing page link
answer a question (price, deal, guarantee)
items.ask: What's the deal you lead with (price, bundle, discount, guarantee)? Paste the page where people buy it.
items.claude_can_fetch: price and guarantee from the offer page (dated)

items.name: Your landing pages
items.why: Briefs get matched to a page that actually sells that product.
how: paste links
items.ask: Do you send ads to any landing pages other than the product page? Paste the links.

items.name: Who your customer is
items.why: Every ad is written for one specific person, not 'everyone'.
how: answer a few questions
Claude drafts the profile from your reviews
items.ask: Describe your typical customer — who buys, what problem they had, and what they tried before you.

items.name: Your customer reviews
items.why: The tools write in your customers' real words, with a receipt on every line.
how: paste the reviews page link — Claude fetches them
or drop a reviews export (CSV)
items.ask: Where are your reviews? Paste the page (your site, Amazon, Trustpilot…) or drop an export file.

items.name: Your customers' words (built for you)
items.why: The language bank every copy tool draws from.
how: nothing to do — Claude builds it from your reviews
items.ask: (No question — Claude builds this from the reviews and tells you when it's done.)

items.name: Surveys and support tickets
items.why: More real customer words, pulled daily.
how: answer a question (which survey sheet / which helpdesk)
items.ask: Do you run a customer survey or a support helpdesk you'd like the tools to learn from? Say which, or 'not now'.

items.name: Your competitors
items.why: The swipe tools pull what's already working for them.
how: answer a question (names or links/handles)
Claude finds their sites and social accounts
items.ask: Who are the 3–5 brands your customers compare you to?

items.name: Ads or posts you'd like to copy the structure of
items.why: This is what the teardown tools take apart and rebuild for your brand.
how: paste links (TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ad Library, YouTube)
or drop files
items.ask: Paste 1–3 videos or image ads you wish were yours — anyone's.

items.name: Your own past ads and content
items.why: The tools learn what already works for you and avoid repeating what didn't.
how: drop files
paste your Meta Ad Library page link
or a Drive folder link
items.ask: Got ads or posts that did well for you? Drop them, or paste your Ad Library page.
items.claude_can_fetch: your public Meta Ad Library page

items.name: Photo shoots and brand videos
items.why: Real footage and photos to cut into new ads.
how: paste a Drive/Dropbox folder link
or drop files
items.ask: Do you have product photos or brand video beyond the product page? Paste a folder link or drop them.

items.name: Creators you work with
items.why: Briefs can be written for a specific creator's style and footage.
how: paste their handles
items.ask: Do you work with any creators or UGC people? Paste their handles, or 'not now'.

items.name: Keys for the tools you use
items.why: Each tool uses your own accounts — nothing is shared. Asked only right before a tool first needs one.
tools: each tool lists its keys in its README
how: Claude tells you which key, where to get it, and opens .env for you to paste it in
items.ask: (Asked just before the first tool that needs it.) This step needs a {KEY} — here's where to get it: {WHERE}. Paste it into the .env file I've opened.

items.name: Google Drive (optional)
items.why: Lets tools save Docs and files into your Drive instead of only on your computer.
how: Claude walks you through it when you first want something saved to Drive
items.ask: Want results saved into a Google Drive folder? (You can skip this — everything is saved on your computer either way.)

items.name: Your Meta ad account (optional)
items.why: Only for uploading ads to Meta or reading how they performed.
how: answer a question (ad account, page and pixel ids — Claude shows you where to find them)
items.ask: Do you want the tools to upload ads to Meta for you? If yes, I'll show you where to find your ad account id.

items.name: Your first teardown
items.why: Proves everything is set up, and gets you your first brief.
tools: video-teardown (or image-teardown for a picture ad)
how: nothing to do — Claude runs it on one of your swipes and shows you the result
items.ask: Ready? I'll take the first swipe you gave me apart and rebuild it for your brand.
